⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I’ve been to Pickles Eatery three times, and I can honestly say that the food and drinks are amazing! What makes this place special is how unique and memorable the food is. Every dish has its own character and stands out from other places I’ve tried. The drinks are just as delicious, too! The fact that I keep coming back says a lot about how much I enjoy this place. Definitely a hidden gem worth visiting, and I’m already looking forward to my next visit! 💚

Great Atmosphere, staff and Food
Feb 2025 • Couples
A great spot for locals and tourists.
My girlfriend and I went to dinner and were very impressed.
The staff were LOVELY and their attention to detail was great😌
The food left me wanting more (cute small plates packed with flavour), and the wine I was recommended was tasty too. 
I was hoping to order the churros, but we arrived late- so they bought us a complementary scoop of ice cream!
The attention to detail included a Polaroid as a parting gift, which made my day.
Thank you!
